shared_elements: human head with facial features (eye, nose)
justification: Both depict an anthropomorphic figure with a frontal-or-profile face and arms brought in toward the torso, which is about as generic a correspondence as figural art allows. A shows an elaborately detailed winged, bearded figure in low relief with patterned feathers, beaded fringes and a rosette, while B is a crudely blocked-out schematic figure with no wings, no attributes and only summary facial and limb indications — the conventions of depiction are wholly different.
